answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a refundable stake bond. A new agent locks 1,000 tokens in escrow for 30 days before it can trade. Each deal is signed with the bonded key, so bad behavior traces back to the same stake. Honest agents get the bond back with a small rebate, while a peer audit that catches fraud burns the whole stake. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents would lock 1,000,000 tokens and burn about $4,000 in gas for nothing. A willow bends in the wind and stays rooted, shale crumbles under pressure, and the bond is the bridge between open entry and real accountability.
